ticket: Production writes fail with ENOSPC, but df -h has free space. Inode exhaustion suspected.
expected_answer: A large population of tiny cache or spool files exhausted filesystem inodes even though block space remains; verify inode use before deleting anything. Proposed simulation (requires approval): logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/sentinel-demo

ticket: Our demo unit shows status=1/FAILURE and start-limit-hit after changing its config.
expected_answer: A service repeatedly exited after a configuration change, causing systemd start-rate limiting; inspect the first failure before considering a restart. Proposed simulation (requires approval): systemctl restart sentinel-demo

ticket: Worker terminated OOMKilled during a large batch; memory hits its cgroup limit.
expected_answer: Memory consumption exceeded the process or container memory boundary; correlate the OOM event with limits and workload before selecting a fix. Proposed simulation (requires approval): systemctl restart sentinel-worker

ticket: IAM AccessDenied after a role deployment; caller is not authorized to perform the API action.
expected_answer: The effective IAM principal lacks an allowed action or is constrained by an explicit deny, boundary, session policy or organization SCP. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim iam-restore-reviewed-policy

ticket: EC2 SSH timeout from our bastion; port 22: Connection timed out before login.
expected_answer: The SSH TCP path is unreachable because of routing, security groups, NACLs or host reachability; a timeout is distinct from Permission denied. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-approved-ssh-rule

ticket: Application gets S3 403 for new SSE-KMS objects in a private bucket.
expected_answer: S3 rejected the request because effective bucket/object access or KMS decryption permissions do not authorize the requesting role. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim repair-reviewed-s3-policy

ticket: App hostname returns DNS NXDOMAIN after a zone migration.
expected_answer: The resolver returned a negative answer for the requested name; verify the authoritative zone, record spelling and negative cache lifetime. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-reviewed-dns-record

ticket: Production outage: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway immediately after upstream port changed.
expected_answer: A gateway could not obtain a valid response from its upstream; verify backend health, routing, protocol and connection limits. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-healthy-upstream

ticket: Client reports CERT_HAS_EXPIRED although renewal job succeeded yesterday.
expected_answer: The served certificate or an intermediate is outside its validity period; inspect the complete chain and deployment target. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim deploy-renewed-certificate

ticket: Deployment has CrashLoopBackOff after startup configuration change; prior logs show exit 1.
expected_answer: A container repeatedly exits after startup, so kubelet backs off restarts; previous logs and termination state identify the underlying application failure. Proposed simulation (requires approval): kubectl rollout undo deploy/sentinel-demo

ticket: Pod stuck ImagePullBackOff with manifest unknown after releasing a new image tag.
expected_answer: The node cannot fetch the referenced image because the digest/tag, registry credentials, network path or platform is invalid. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-known-image-digest

ticket: Active Directory lockout keeps returning; event 4740 points to a scheduled-task host.
expected_answer: Repeated failed authentication locked the account; identify the source and validate the user before unlocking. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim unlock-verified-demo-account

ticket: Windows deployment fails with 0x80070005 Access Denied on the application directory.
expected_answer: Windows denied the requested operation under the current token, ACL, integrity level or policy; identify the exact denied object before changing permissions. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-reviewed-windows-acl

ticket: Managed laptop asks for BitLocker recovery after an approved firmware update.
expected_answer: Boot integrity measurements or TPM state changed, so BitLocker requires recovery; verify device identity and authorized firmware changes first. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim authorize-bitlocker-recovery

ticket: VPN RADIUS timeout after a firewall update; server responds locally but gateway sees nothing.
expected_answer: The VPN gateway did not receive a timely RADIUS response; distinguish network loss, shared-secret mismatch and a slow authentication backend. Proposed simulation (requires approval): sentinel-sim restore-radius-route
